classes._post: post = render scale of the post chain (EffectComposer) in CSS px x post; null = the renderer DPR. Capped by the renderer DPR and px; never below 1; saver / ?look=0 = 1

devices._note: model identifier -> [RAM GB, name]. Unconfirmed identifiers are left out and take the unknown path (iPhone -> phone, iPad -> tablet): iPhone 17e, iPad Pro (M5), iPad Air (M4). An unknown identifier older than the oldest one listed here (lower major number) is low

screens._note: Web 版の機種の推定（MR.Cine.guessModel）: screen の短い辺 x 長い辺 @ devicePixelRatio → 同じ画面の機種 id（RAM は devices）。拡大表示（Display Zoom）だと小さい機種の値になる

tod._note: time of day (www/js/tod.js, plan time-of-day.md). One preset per game: online / arena / harness = dusk, else setting mirrsona.tod or default (auto = weights by seed). dusk {} = the level sky and render values unchanged. Keys are the base under weather: sky (over level sky; disc false = no sun disc, moon = stars when no image), hemi.mul, fog.mul (city altitude fogNear/fogFar), exposure (x render.exposure), grade (over render.look.grade), windows.glow (x windowEmissive / farWindowGlow), windows.lit (x farWindowLit / farlook litOffice / litHome, max 1), lamps (x propEmissive), landmarkNight (0..1, replaces render.city.landmarkNight.night), enemySight (x solo AI detect / attack range), weather (weather_view.js: the weather state colours are tuned for dusk; per key lit / shade / cir (default clouds) / ov / fog / haze (default fog) / sun / rain = { sat (0 = grey of the linear luminance, 1 = as is), mul (number or linear [r, g, b]) }, hemiSky / hemiGround (sRGB hex, the overcast hemisphere colours); no block = unchanged)

look._note: cinematic-interiors V2 X1 (farlook.js): far-city window colours (weights in %, groundOnly = indices only on the ground floor), lit share per building (offices = styles 3-6 in blocks of blockFloors floors x blockBays bays, homes = brick styles 1-2 scattered; far windows = average colour + farVar of the 4x3 block colour), roof palette, per-building tint (value +-, hue +- degrees, saturation x). enabled false or ?look=0 = off

underground._note: nyc-complete NC6 (world.js _surfaceHide): while the camera is in a station void, surface chunks / ground stay drawn only within openingRange m of a stair opening (and above the pit floor - openingDepth m); LOD, skyline, props and landmarks are hidden. Near an opening (surface level 1) the street chunk meshes, vehicles and enemies are drawn only inside the view frustum through the opening (the pit rectangle at the sidewalk top widened by portalPad m; no culling while the camera is within portalLip m of the sidewalk top); deep (level 2) surface vehicles / enemies are not drawn. No shadow-map pass while underground (the sun is 0 there)

facade._note: buildings-hq B1: v2 の街（manhattan）の外壁の窓をシェーダーで描く（www/js/facade.js）。enabled false / ?facade=0 = 今まで通りのテクスチャの壁。lit = 灯りの割合の倍率（時間帯の farWindowLit にも掛かる）、parapet = 屋上の手前の窓を描かない帯 m、plainGids / plainCls = 窓なしにする gid（24 自由の女神と砦）とクラス、minEdge = これより短い辺は窓なし m
facade._noteB3: B3: midtown（v1 の箱）も同じ材質。litCurve = 時間帯の farWindowLit（夕方 1・夜 1.3）→ 灯りの倍率（夕方 0.75 = 25〜35 %）、glowCurve → 窓の発光の倍率（夜 1）、litRun = 一緒に点く事務所の間の数、litFloor = 階ぜんぶ点く割合、litSingle = 1 つだけの窓。midtown.bay.default は citykit のれんがの窓の格子（3 m）と同じにする（エアコンが窓に載る）
facade._noteB31: B3.1: 9 間の升ごとに 1 つ（9 間 = litWhole）か 2 つ（litRun の間）の事務所。litGap = 点いた事務所の中の消えた窓、litEdge = 事務所の端の窓が消える割合、litBoost = 事務所の点く割合の倍率（消えた窓の分）。litFloor × 灯り = 階ぜんぶ

city._stations: nyc-complete NC8: subway stations online (v2 levels with plan.underground). The client (game.js _railOpts) and the server (server/cityworld.js CityWorld.stationsOn: online.levels.<id>.city.stations first) read the same key; false = both without stations (no voids / pits / station loot on either side). The server reads its bundled game.json: flip it only together with a server deploy

underground._note: nyc-complete NC6 (game.js _underFog / _underLight): in a station void the far plane is far m, fog fogNear..fogFar in fogColor, sun x sunMul, hemisphere light x hemiMul in hemiSky / hemiGround, env map x envMul (no weather), sky dome hidden (deep levels only). Entering / leaving a void blends street -> underground light, fog and far over blendSec s (smoothstep); a camera jump > blendJump m switches at once
